sentence_stem: It is very cold today, so
correct_completion: I am wearing my warm coat.
full_sentence: It is very cold today, so I am wearing my warm coat.
acceptable_variants: I am wearing a warm hat.

options.text: I am swimming in the sea.
options.why_wrong: Swimming in the sea does not follow from cold weather. 'So' introduces a logical result of the situation in the first part.
This describes a different fact about the weather, not a result of the cold.

options.text: I am wearing my warm coat.

options.why_wrong: This adds a fact about shoes but is not a result of the cold weather.

explanation: After 'so', we give the result of the situation described in the first part. Here the cold weather is the reason, so the completion must be a logical result of the cold.
translation: Dzisiaj jest bardzo zimno, więc mam na sobie mój ciepły płaszcz.
